newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged even as funds flow in.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged even as funds flow in.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday as mild inflows of foreign funds balanced the U.S. unit's relative strength overseas.
Dealers said they saw little likelihood of major movements.
The local dollar ended at an its intraday high of T$27.495, the same as Monday's close. Turnover through dealers was an active US$218 million. Tuesday was a market holiday.

"Wednesday's trade was trendless," said one dealer. "But I did see some inflows of foreign funds, offsetting the Taiwan dollar's earlier fall, which was triggered by the strength of the U.S. dollar overseas," he said.

Another dealer said it was possible foreign funds would take profits in the stock market and repatriate their money as the year-end bookclosing period nears, a move that could pressure the Taiwan dollar lower.
"Overall no major direction for the Taiwan dollar is seen and its movement will either follow the U.S. dollar trend overseas or, locally, foreign funds' movements," the first dealer said.
The Taiwan dollar was seen continuing to trade in a narrow T$27.47-27.52 range on Thursday and in the near term.
